watches.name: GENESIS Stainless Steel - Black Crystallised Titanium Dial, Swiss Movt
watches.description: The Genesis has returned, after a hiatus of 10 years. It retains the original 44mm case of surgical-grade 316L stainless steel, but is subtly redesigned. Crystallised titanium sandwich dials are rare in watchmaking. For the first time ever, our signature dial, of sandwich construction with hour indices at 12, 3, 6 and 9 o'clock positions and dot minute markers, is forged from crystallised titanium. It glows like a torch in the dark, thanks to the generous application of Swiss Super-LumiNova of the highest grade. The timepiece is powered by the venerable Sellita SW200-1 Swiss automatic movement, and is water resistant to 200m/ 660ft.

watches.name: VANGUARD Stainless Steel w/ Date – Luminous Forged Carbon Dial
watches.description: The Vanguard, with its 42mm 316L stainless steel case, captures raw, industrial character in a way that's seldom seen in the world of watches. The lume-infused forged carbon sandwich dial, another novelty from Gruppo Gamma, amplifies its rugged, distressed personality. Telling the time has never been easier, with oversized indices, angular hands and a cleverly designed date window. Premium Swiss Super-LumiNova luminescence dominates low-light conditions with unwavering brilliance. This Vanguard timepiece is powered by the venerable Miyota 9015 Japanese automatic movement, and is water resistant to 100m/ 330ft.

watches.name: PEACEMAKER Bronze - Green Fumé Dial, Swiss Manual Movt
watches.description: The Peacemaker, with its 43mm case made of marine-grade CuSn8 bronze, embraces impermanence and is designed to be marked by life. The smoky gradient green dial, in sandwich construction, cuts through noise in the historically correct hour, minute and small seconds format. It shines like a torch in the dark, thanks to the generous application of Swiss Super-LumiNova of the highest grade. If you're interested in a bronzo built by artisans who perfected the craft through years of experience, and that's available in very limited quantities, look no further. The timepiece is powered by the venerable Sellita SW219-1 Swiss manual movement, and is water resistant to 200m/ 660ft.

watches.description: Track different time zones with one quick glance, for work or travel. Clean, back-to-basics design. Evergreen matte black dial in a 40mm 316L stainless steel case, d esigned to look great with integrated bracelet or various leather, canvas and rubber straps. Prominent display of date, hours, minutes, seconds, a second time zone, and the blue glow of premium Swiss Super-LumiNova ensure readability at all times. Water resistance of 200m/ 660ft ensures it can keep up with your everyday activities. The Field Watch GMT is powered by the reliable NH34A automatic movement from Seiko Instruments, Japan.
